description: Go Asset Service and Python Attack Path Engine. The Asset Service handles asset data models, ingestion pipeline, relationship mapping, criticality scoring, and REST API. The Attack Path Engine handles attack graph construction, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, scoring, Monte Carlo simulation, and CVE-based vulnerability scoring.
steps: Create /backend/asset-service/go.mod with module path github.com/cyberajju/ARES-X/backend/asset-service
Create /backend/asset-service/main.go with server startup, config loading, graceful shutdown
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/config/config.go with configuration (DB URL, server port, log level, ingestion settings)

Create /backend/asset-service/internal/models/asset.go with comprehensive asset models: Asset (base with ID, Name, Type, Criticality, Status, metadata, timestamps), Server (OS, IP, services, patches), Network (CIDR, VLAN, zone), Identity (type, privileges, last_auth), CloudResource (provider, region, service_type, config), OTDevice (protocol, firmware, zone, safety_level)
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/models/relationship.go with AssetRelationship model (source, target, relationship_type, confidence, metadata)
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/models/scoring.go with CriticalityScore model and scoring factors (business_impact, exposure, vulnerability_density, connectivity_score)
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/repository/asset_repo.go with repository interface and in-memory implementation (ListAssets, GetByID, Create, Update, Delete, Search, BulkCreate)
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/services/ingestion.go with asset ingestion pipeline - validation, normalization, deduplication, relationship inference
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/services/scoring.go with criticality scoring algorithm - weighted factors (business impact 0.3, exposure 0.25, vuln density 0.25, connectivity 0.2)
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/services/relationship.go with relationship mapping logic - auto-discovers relationships based on network proximity, shared services, authentication flows
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/handlers/assets.go with HTTP handlers for all asset CRUD operations with proper validation and error responses
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/handlers/ingestion.go with handlers for bulk import and ingestion status
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/router/router.go with route setup and middleware
Create /backend/asset-service/internal/middleware/logging.go with request logging
Create /backend/asset-service/migrations/001_create_assets.sql with PostgreSQL schema for assets, relationships, and scoring tables
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/requirements.txt with FastAPI, uvicorn, pydantic, numpy dependencies listed
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/pyproject.toml with project metadata and dependencies
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/__init__.py
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/main.py with FastAPI application setup, CORS, lifespan, router includes
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/config.py with pydantic Settings class for configuration
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/models/attack_path.py with Pydantic models: AttackPath, PathStep, AttackTechnique, PathScore, SimulationResult
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/models/graph.py with Pydantic models for graph representation: AttackNode, AttackEdge, AttackGraph
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/models/vulnerability.py with CVE model, CVSS scoring, VulnerabilityAssessment
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/graph_builder.py with attack graph construction from infrastructure graph - converts infra topology into attack-relevant graph with exploit edges

Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/mitre_mapping.py with MITRE ATT&CK TTP mapping - maps asset types and vulnerabilities to relevant techniques and tactics (hardcoded subset of framework)
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/scoring.py with path scoring: probability calculation (product of edge probabilities), impact scoring (sum of node criticalities), combined risk score

Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/simulation.py with Monte Carlo simulation for compromise probability - runs N iterations with randomized edge success probabilities, returns statistical distribution
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/vulnerability.py with CVE-based vulnerability scoring - CVSS to probability conversion, exploit availability factors, patch status
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/services/path_finder.py with attack path algorithms - finds all viable attack paths, prioritizes by risk score, identifies quick wins vs. high-impact paths

Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/api/routes.py with FastAPI router: POST /compute (compute paths), GET /paths (list computed paths), GET /paths/{id} (path details), POST /simulate (Monte Carlo), GET /techniques (MITRE mappings)
Create /backend/attack-path-engine/app/api/dependencies.py with FastAPI dependencies (service injection)
acceptance_criteria: Go asset service compiles with 'go build ./...' (stdlib only)
Python code passes AST parsing (python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(...)')
Asset models cover all required types (servers, networks, identities, cloud, OT)
Criticality scoring uses weighted multi-factor algorithm
Attack path engine implements Monte Carlo simulation
MITRE ATT&CK mapping covers at least 10 techniques
CVE scoring converts CVSS to probability correctly
verification: Validate all Python files with: python3 -c 'import ast, sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in sys.argv[1:]]' on all .py files
